items.item_text: Currently certified by the State of California as a Phlebotomist (CT PHLEBOT)
Current American Heart Association BLS certificate (CT CPRBLS)

Must properly identify all in-patients prior to specimen collection by matching information present on patient arm band with information on laboratory requisition. Verbal identification with patient also a must when patient condition allows such feedback
Must properly identify all outpatients prior to specimen collection by matching information on outpatient slip with verbal communication with the patient or patient's guardian/guarantor.
Must properly identify all specimens coming from outpatient clients by matching the information on the tube with that from the laboratory requisition.

Must properly identify and band all patients for blood bank by comparing information on patient arm band with that on the blood bank requisition. This information must be transferred to the blood bank arm band and the tube per phlebotomy procedure manual. Arm bands are to be placed on the patient's right arm.
Must be able to collect laboratory specimens on patients who range in age from infants through geriatrics.
Must have knowledge of specimen requirements for all tests performed at French Hospital and be able to look up requirements for specimens sent to our reference laboratories.
